title: Remote access — setup inside the panel you already have

steps.headline: Say what is actually missing, instead of warning about the other device first.
steps.changed: Today the panel opens with a yellow warning about your phone, even before anything is installed on this computer. It now says the plain thing — not set up yet — with the one button that moves you forward.
steps.notice: The box, the wording style and the button are the panel's existing ones. Nothing new was invented.

steps.headline: One yellow box asks before your computer's name is published.
steps.changed: A secure connection publishes this computer's name in a public certificate record. There is no step for that today. It uses the same yellow box the panel already uses for things to read first.
steps.notice: Your conversations and files stay private — only the machine name is public.

steps.headline: Devices have names, and removing one actually removes its access.
steps.changed: Devices were raw IP addresses with a Disconnect that let them straight back in. They now have names, a device you are not using stays listed as Offline, and Revoke means it has to pair again. Skip password on Tailscale is gone.
steps.notice: Enabled, Password, Keep awake and Add Device are untouched.
steps.risk: Tailnet devices now need a password.
